    if fingers is not None: a[7:]=fingers

        s.step(a)

def move(s, pos, quat=DOWN, fingers=.04, speed=.012, settle=5):
    p0,q0=pose(s); pos=np.array(pos,float); quat=np.array(quat,float)
    rots=Rotation.from_quat(np.array([q0,quat])[:,[1,2,3,0]])
    angle=(rots[1]*rots[0].inv()).magnitude()
    n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(pos-p0)/speed)),int(np.ceil(angle/.08)))
    sl=Slerp([0,1],rots)
    for t in np.linspace(0,1,n+1)[1:]:
        if s.done: break
        p=p0*(1-t)+pos*t
        q=sl([t]).as_quat()[0][[3,0,1,2]]
        ik=s.ik(p,q)
        if not ik['success']: print('IK failed',p,flush=True)
        s.step(np.r_[ik['joint_positions'],[fingers,fingers]])
